object_description: offset school extension over a fully underground sports hall whose roof becomes the central break area
geometry_property: hall roof used as break area
compact above and below ground volumes
design_condition: the sports area is placed entirely underground and the school extension offset from the existing buildings so that the valuable open spaces are preserved and the hall roof becomes the new centre of the complex

positive: The area is understood as a complex of generous open spaces with representative school buildings
Putting the sports area entirely underground preserves the valuable open spaces
The roof of the sports hall becomes a centrally located break area and the new centre of the facility
This leads to a relaxed and attractive urban ensemble uniting buildings from very different eras
The complex gains an overarching identity through the striking break area
Plenty of space is left for the individual buildings and good access situations are created
Breaking up the block-like figure into individual staggered buildings structures and networks the open spaces
Users enter via a spatially attractive entrance hall that is easy to use and furnish
The ground floor with library and school kitchen offers the right functions for a busy zone between school and leisure
Two staircases of different meaning lead either to the school rooms or to the underground sports area
The simple basic structure of the two-sided corridor school is very carefully worked out
The authors achieve generous and attractive open spaces and integrate the extension harmoniously
Compact underground and above-ground volumes and a lightweight facade improve the sustainability targets
The urban planning potential of the chosen approach is great
The jury praised the overall very careful design and in many parts an excellent contribution
negative: The large underground volume and overall large envelope area will exceed the target costs
Underground buildings are judged less sustainable during construction and future renewal
Whether the proposal creates a contemporary architecture strong enough to stand between the listed buildings was intensively discussed
More independence and freshness would probably have further strengthened the very intelligent concept
